result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promo banner's white text sits on a pale mint background and is nearly unreadable, which hides the offer and its promo code. The rest of the page looks correct. The clipped carousel items and the partially visible bottom card were excluded as intended behaviour.

issues.description: In the promo banner, the headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very light mint background. Contrast is far below WCAG minimums, so users can barely see the offer or the promo code they need at checkout. Only the 'Order now' button is clearly legible.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text (such as the dark green or near-black used elsewhere) on the light mint background, or switch to a saturated dark-green background so the white text stays. Aim for at least 4.5:1 contrast for the subtext and 3:1 for the large headline. Also check that the decorative circles behind the text don't reduce legibility further.
